imprint.title: Imprint
imprint.contactHint: Contact details are provided on request.
imprint.disclaimer: This site is an independent third-party aggregator and is not affiliated with any of the referenced publishers. All trademarks and logos mentioned in article titles remain the property of their respective owners.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This site stores only the metadata needed to display news headlines: title, publication date, source name, and link. Article bodies, snippets, images, or videos are never copied.
privacy.dataBody: Your visit is served by Azure Static Web Apps and an Azure Functions API. We do not set cookies, we do not run client-side analytics or advertising trackers, and we do not profile users.
privacy.logsBody: The server-side Application Insights instance records anonymized request metadata (path, response time, user-agent category) for up to 30 days to investigate errors and performance. IP addresses are not stored.
privacy.thirdPartyBody: Every news item links out to the original publisher. Opening such a link transfers you to that publisher's site; their privacy policy applies from that point.
privacy.rightsBody: Under GDPR you have the right to request information, correction, or deletion of personal data. Contact details are listed in the imprint.
